sourceObservation.note: Observed migration code is partial evidence only; this contract is the promotion gate.

requiredRules: never overwrite or delete a user-owned file
a generated marker alone is insufficient ownership proof
replace or delete a generated file only when its current digest matches the last published digest in retained generator metadata
generation receipts bind owner, generator identity, source identity, previous digest, and published digest

cacheIdentity.promotionRule: No cache hit is admissible unless every required field participates in the canonical cache-key digest.

requiredRules: entry project identity equals the requesting project identity
entry cache key equals the fully recomputed expected cache key
artifact path is normalized and confined to the cache root
artifact is a regular non-symlink file
executable is declared as a normalized path under an admitted project or toolchain root; PATH lookup is not an execution authority
arguments are an argv array and are never passed through a shell string
the child environment starts empty and only declared allowlisted variables are projected
plugin protocol version and compatible CLI contract version are explicit
working directory is declared and confined to an admitted root
pluginExecution.observedMigrationConcern: Legacy build-step code contains dynamic Command::new(program) and .envs(...) calls; those paths are not evidence of a constrained extension-command API.
